title_candidates: Subah ka Alarm, Rohan ki Kahani
opening_hook: Rohan subah alarm sunke bhi phone check karta tha, lekin ek din sab badal gaya.
narration: Rohan ek chhota sa ladka tha jo subah alarm sunke bhi phone check karta tha. Ek din usne decide kiya ki woh roz 5 baje uthega aur timer set karega. Har raat wo apni notebook ka page khol ke next day ki routine likhta. Pehle to uska focus tut-ta, par usne practice ki aur har din 10 minute meditation ki. Aaj usne apna alarm bina snooze kiye band kiya, phone side pe rakh diya, aur kitchen mein chai banate hue apna first page likha. Yeh choti jeet uske confidence ko boost kar gayi, aur ab wo har roz disciplined feel karta hai.
story_beats: Hook: Rohan, a small boy, still checks his phone after the morning alarm.
Problem: He realizes his habit of snoozing and scrolling steals his precious early hours.
Conflict: Determined to change, he decides to wake up at 5 am, set a timer, and write his next‑day routine each night, but his focus keeps breaking.
Turning point: He adds a daily 10‑minute meditation and places his phone aside, finally turning off the alarm without snoozing and writing his first page while making tea.
Resolution: The small victory boosts his confidence, and he now feels disciplined every day.
Closing message: Har choti jeet se banta hai bada confidence, bas lagataar practice karo.
